text:
sam: quick postmortem follow-up proposal after cache-blip — want a low-friction way to lock owners, ETAs, and a short cadence so items don't fall off.
jess: absolutely, that outage exposed drift. i can spin up a tracker.
sam: rough timeline template to standardize commitments:
```
T0: postmortem draft + initial action items listed (owner assigned)
T+72h: owners set detailed remediation plan + ETA (PR link if relevant)
T+14d: implementation check-in (merged / blockers noted)
T+30d: monitoring & alerting updated + smoke verify
T+60d: regression review + final close or escalate
```
alex: add a weekly 15m async check-in until >80% closed? keeps momentum.
morgan: agree. propose tracker columns: id, description, owner, started, eta, status (todo/in-progress/blocked/done), blocker, next_check, link. low ceremony.
jess: ok i'll make the sheet and a tiny dashboard view (counts by status). aim to post link in #eng-oncall by EOD tomorrow.
sam: roles proposal: Incident Commander (rotates every 6 weeks), Remediation Owner (per action), PM Reviewer, SRE Verifier. IC assigns owners within 24h of postmortem publication.
alex: volunteering for next IC window. happy to own tagging current postmortem actions and entering etas. @morgan can you note me as interim?
incident-bot: Reminder set: "postmortem-check: cache-blip-2026" in 14 days for @alex
morgan: noted. i'll update the public rotation calendar and ping for volunteers. also suggest we add a 15-min weekly triage until items hit 80% done, timeboxed.
sam: concrete immediate tasks:
- tracker sheet + minimal dashboard (jess) — due EOD tomorrow
- add timeline template to incident runbook (sam) — due Wed
- update IC rotation calendar + call for volunteers (morgan) — due Mon
- annotate current postmortem with action IDs and owners (alex) — due in 2 days
jess: got it, will share link and a single-row template for copy/paste into postmortems.
alex: will sync owners and add initial statuses.
morgan: once tracker exists we run the 15m weekly until 80% closure, then revert to monthly pulse.
sam: sounds good. small expectation: owners should update their row before the weekly check. low friction = more compliance.
jess: no objections. sharing sheet in ~6h. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks all.
morgan: closing loop 90% done on calendar update, will post in #people-ops and ping for coverage.
